label: Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodlines sandboxes
description: How Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodlines sandboxes deploy, and how to find the game on this machine. Paths: vortex.

notes: Mods are files in the Vampire folder, which is the game's own mod directory. Total-conversion patches such as the Unofficial Patch also use an Unofficial_Patch folder in the game root.
Hard links are the default: the game folder and the staging folder are almost always on one drive, and nothing is copied twice when two sandboxes share a mod.
